title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 51
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 51: the destroying wind against Babylon, the golden cup, the kings of the Medes, and the book cast into the Euphrates.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will raise up against Babylon?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will raise up against Babylon, and against those who dwell in Lebkamai, a destroying wind.

answers.text: A flood out of the sea
A famine of seven years
A plague of locusts
A destroying wind

questions.text: What has Babylon been in Yahweh's hand?
questions.explanation: Babylon has been a golden cup in Yahweh's hand, who made all the earth drunk, so that the nations drank of her wine and went mad.

answers.text: A sharp sickle in the time of harvest
A golden cup that made all the earth drunk
A burning lamp set on the mountains
A strong shield against the nations

questions.text: Whose spirit has Yahweh stirred up, because his purpose is against Babylon?
questions.explanation: Yahweh has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes, because his purpose is against Babylon, to destroy it.

answers.text: The kings of Egypt
The kings of Edom
The kings of the Medes
The princes of Judah

questions.text: What does verse 15 say he has stretched out by his understanding?
questions.explanation: He has made the earth by his power, established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding he has stretched out the heavens.

answers.text: The heavens
The sea
The mountains
The clouds

questions.text: What is said about every goldsmith and his image?
questions.explanation: Every goldsmith is disappointed by his image, for his molten image is falsehood and there is no breath in them.

answers.text: He grows rich from the images that he makes
He refuses to make any image of the gods
He is praised among the nations for his work
He is disappointed by it, for it is falsehood with no breath

questions.text: What does Yahweh call the one he addresses in verse 20?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says: You are my battle ax and weapons of war. With you I will break the nations into pieces.

answers.text: My shepherd and my staff
My battle ax and weapons of war
My cup of wrath for the nations
My servant Jacob and my inheritance

questions.text: What does Yahweh call the one he is against in verse 25, and what will he make it?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says: Behold, I am against you, destroying mountain, and he will roll it down from the rocks and make it a burned mountain.

answers.text: A destroying mountain, which he will make a burned mountain
A fruitful field, which he will make a desert
A high tower, which he will make a heap of stones
A green tree, which he will make dry wood

questions.text: Which kingdoms are called together against her?
questions.explanation: The call is to prepare the nations against her and to call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni and Ashkenaz.

answers.text: Kedar, Hazor and Dedan
Hamath, Arpad and Damascus
Ararat, Minni and Ashkenaz
Moab, Ammon and Edom

questions.text: What is said about the mighty men of Babylon?
questions.explanation: The mighty men of Babylon have stopped fighting and remain in their strongholds; their might has failed and they have become as women.

answers.text: They went out to meet the enemy in the field
They fled away to the land of Egypt
They tore down their own walls and gates
They have stopped fighting and their might has failed

questions.text: What did Jeremiah tell Seraiah to do with the book after reading it in Babylon?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah said that when he had finished reading the book, he should bind a stone to it and cast it into the middle of the Euphrates.

answers.text: Burn it in the fire before the king of Babylon
Bind a stone to it and cast it into the middle of the Euphrates
Bury it in the ground inside the city
Carry it back to Jerusalem and read it there
